comment: One-button launch table (every WoW game Battle.net installs; see WowFlavor for the catalog). uid is the --game= / -uid / InstallState id; Play opens the game with Battle.net.exe --game=<uid> and clicks its Play button. execCodes (Battle.net.exe --exec="launch <code>") only select the game on Battle.net 2.53 and are kept for forcePath testing. Confidence: verified = proven on device; community = public sources only. See docs/WEHAVEPHONES_APP.md, section Play.

products.note: Battle.net's InstallState and product.db uid is wow_classic_anniversary; the TACT product code in .build.info is wow_anniversary.
Hosts the World of Warcraft: Forever beta (1.60.x, Sept-Oct 2026); product code from Blizzard forum installs

World of Warcraft: Forever (product wowf, directory _forever_); offered since 2026-10-15 as the October 19 Forever Stress Test and reused for the live game launching 2026-11-04. uid and product come from the launcher's InstallState/ProductManager data; the scanner picks the real exe and the direct rung uses the -uid from the launcher log. Hot-fix with launch-overrides.json.

playButton.comment: Battle.net's Play button in X pixels from the main window's left and bottom edges, measured on the S23 (1280x720 X screen, Battle.net 2.53; the button spans 39-272 across and 81-136 up). Battle.net starts with --game=<uid> on the game's page; Play is clicked every waitSeconds until the game starts (the page can take minutes to render); after attempts clicks Battle.net is restarted, up to restarts times (it sometimes hangs before its page renders).
